name: Devastating Collision

stealth.note: (master) to hear the roar of hover jets

description: A phantom hover truck collides with creatures, replaying an accident from the past in gory detail.
disable: DC 38 Occultism (master) to disperse the phantom truck, or DC 36 Religion (master) to ward yourself from harm

offensiveAbilities.name: Crash
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature crosses the street

Effect A phantom hover truck crashes into all creatures crossing the street, dealing (6d12+37) Bludgeoning Damage damage (DC 43 Fortitude Saving Throw save).

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage, is knocked Prone, and is pushed 10 feet back.

Failure The creature takes full damage, is knocked prone, and is pushed 20 feet back.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage, is knocked prone, and is pushed 30 feet back.
